# Public authenticated transport fixture

These four data files are exact copies of the protected promotion 42086237382 `runtime-draft-receipts` public checkpoint: `draft.json`, `validated/validated.json` (stored here as `validated.json`), and `signed/runtime-linux-x64.json` plus its raw detached signature. Native source/run: 16ec1744e1d0cbc6a43960b968a3a7b55a1724a6 / 42068062946; promotion controller: 8873130b08836ef12a517e6f7e4edb461e15496e. They retain historical release 435513734, sequence 1, and original Linux release asset 714228326. The production signature is verified with the unchanged embedded key; no test signing key is created or accepted.

No runtime archive, executable, private key, profile or database is included. Tests model the read-only Actions API/download boundary and reject any call to a controlled forbidden draft403 endpoint. The optional positive full-byte transport case requires `OPENROTMG_INSTALLER_TRANSPORT_ARCHIVE` to identify the original Linux native `runtime-inputs/C/runtime-linux-x64.tar.gz`; it checks its actual 50675204 bytes and SHA256 `47494f3f82d8e3173ade702e5774f047e5a2bf4d15b3304fd820231013b2c47d`, without unpacking or executing it. Without that explicit local input this one test is visibly skipped; normal hosted prepare consumes and checks the real Actions artifact independently.
